design: Broad-shouldered veteran watch commander with deep brown golden-speckled hide, weathered broad mandibles, one long facial scar that does not obscure eyes, grey-streaked heavy dreadlocks half tied back. A tall ridged bronze brow half-helmet leaves alien mandibles visible. Heavy asymmetrical dark plate cuirass with narrow diagonal sash of worn oxblood cloth, tiered shoulder fins, long split leather coat tails, armored knee bands. Holds a plain ceremonial dark staff spear upright with left hand, right hand resting across belt. Authoritative calm stance.
